logp.method_description: The logarithmic partition coefficient (log P) between 1-octanol and water phases was determined for copper complexes using the shake flask method according to the OECD guidelines and Klose with slight modifications.20, 21 The copper compounds (4–6) were dissolved in water (Milli-Q, pre-saturated with 1-octanol) to yield stock solutions of 0.5 mM. An equal volume of n-octanol (pre-saturated with ultrapure water) was added to the copper-containing aqueous solutions, and the mixtures were shaken mechanically for 2 h at room temperature. The samples were centrifuged to separate water and octanol phases. The experiments were performed in duplicates. The initial stock solution and the final aqueous phase obtained were acid digested (HNO3, 50 %), calcinated at 500 °C for 20 min, and dissolved in 1 % HNO3 to match the linear range of the ICP-AES system.
